facts.text: Governors Village earned the 2009 'Community of the Year' award from the North Carolina Chapter of the Community Associations Institute.
Across the street from Governors Village lies Governors Club, a 1,600‑acre gated community featuring a 27‑hole Jack Nicklaus Signature Golf Course.
The original Governors Village Shopping Center opened in 2000 with a grocery store, later adding a dry cleaner, nail salon, and food take‑out shops.
In 2005 a second shopping center opened in Governors Village, offering restaurants, a veterinarian, and a dentist’s office.
The Commons @ Governors Village opened in 2012, housing a realty firm, independent pharmacy, construction firm, and an insurance office in 2016.
Community donations support local hospitals, potentially saving up to three lives, with a blood drive scheduled through the Blood Connection.
